known_limitations: Spot BTCUSDT 15m bars are NOT staged anywhere in the repo/catalog (measured via find across repo root and the CHR3F worktree catalog) — data-gate items 6 is BLOCKED-until-staged; this is the largest open precondition at GO-1.

Staged perp bars cover only 2025-08-20T02:45Z..2026-08-20T02:29:59.999Z (measured, 35,039 contiguous 15m rows, zero intra-series gaps) in the catalog channel 'BTCUSDT-PERP.BINANCE-15-MINUTE-LAST-EXTERNAL' — windows earlier than that require vision monthly klines; the catalog parquets under crypto_perpetual/BTCUSDT-PERP.BINANCE/ are instrument-DEFINITION snapshots (1 row each, onboardDate 2019-09-25T08:00Z measured, corroboration-only per CHR3F), not bars (dispatch wording nuance, disclosed).

Catalog perp bars are bar-CLOSE-stamped ('...:14:59.999' style) and LAST(last-trade)-price, byte-encoded fixed precision; vision/fapi klines are bar-OPEN-stamped — mixing legs without normalizing shifts one leg 15 minutes; mark/index 15m series are not staged and must come from fapi markPriceKlines/indexPriceKlines as separate channels if needed.

Measured pre-floor divergence: vision-derived funding panel (research/control/bear_opportunity_recon_2026-09/data_a2/funding_events.parquet, cols calc_time/funding_interval_hours/last_funding_rate) starts 2019-09-10, before the fapi floor 2020-07-18 (CHR3F §2), and carries a '...:00.001' stamp residue — both feed the mandatory minute-quantization and exclusion-not-merge checks in the spec.
fapi /fapi/v1/fundingRate serves {symbol,fundingTime,fundingRate} per precedent rows; there is NO fundingCount field — settlement counts are census-derived (Q-8 field-name law recorded in spec §1).

Predicted funding (fapi premiumIndex lastFundingRate) vs settled separation is specified as a structural quarantine (separate loader/tag/grep audit) but no code exists yet in this lane to enforce it — it is a child-cycle gate item with PASS/FAIL semantics.

BLOCKED and unmeasurable today: liquidation tape, borrow rates / spot-margin terms, queue position / maker fills, second-venue funding (OKX/Bybit), replay-vs-fill slippage (paper tier, no own fills) — each with its unblock condition in spec §5.

No truncation-replay fixture was runnable in this lane (no child engine exists yet at council stage); the byte-identical panel-truncation proof is specified as gate item 5 for the child to run at GO-1.
